firstPlayerRule: The player holding the four-submarine card is the captain and leads the first trick.
clarifications: The captain also starts task selection, which proceeds clockwise. Mission-specific task-allocation instructions still apply.
The captain leads the first trick even in missions without tasks. The winner of each trick leads the next.
